{{Top|leg}}
A '''starship tool kit'''<ref name="DESB">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> also known as a '''starship repair tool kit'''<ref name="FC">{{JournalCite|1|First Contact}}</ref> was a [[Tool kit/Legends|tool kit]] specifically designed to be used to repair [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] commonly carried a starship tool kit.<ref name="DESB" />
